$comment: Authorization request (specification: basic/authorization). resource MUST be sent (RFC 8707) whether or not the authorization server supports it; PKCE uses S256 (OAuth 2.1 §7.5.2); the specification says state is "if used", and this client always uses it. Before redirecting, the client MUST record the issuer and keep it in the same per-request record as the PKCE verifier and state.
